sloka: जानुभिर् मुष्टिभिर् दन्तैस् तलैः च अभिहतो भृशम् ।परिणीतो अस्मि हरिभिर् बलवद्भिर् अमर्षणैः ॥६-३०-८॥।।
transliteration: jānubhir muṣṭibhir dantais talaiḥ ca abhihato bhṛśam ।pariṇīto asmi haribhir balavadbhir amarṣaṇaiḥ ॥6-30-8॥।।

translations.english: "The monkeys had beaten me with fists, bitten my palms with teeth, beaten me intensely and paraded me in the army indignantly."
